liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Loser** (1 review): The source praises a track it calls Wharf Rat for its dynamics, ranging from whisper to scream [4]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): The Sugar Magnolia into Caution segment is called impeccable and an overlooked highlight of 1972 [7]
- **Caution (Do Not Stop On Tracks)** (1 review): Notes the Caution into Uncle John's Band transition on the newly surfaced complete soundboard [9]

## Setlist highlights

- **Two Souls In Communion**: rare: 10 archived performances [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1972-03-22.132726.sbd.miller.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 28 songs; 216 min; rated 4.18/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: Soundboard has vocal mics prominent in the mix, burying the instruments [15]
- **gd72-03-22.aud.partial.19142.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 2 songs; 29 min; rated 4/5 by 4 [3]. Said about its sound: Describes the audience recording as extremely muffled and distant, as if miked from a faraway bathroom [5]
- **gd1972-03-22.136682.sbd.sirmick.flac1648**: soundboard; 29 songs; 188 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer treats the Academy as a home venue and recalls audience clapping during Playing In The Band [6]
- Parts of this show appeared on a rare bonus disc given with pre-orders of the Rockin' The Rhein set [13]
- Long first set of 16 songs, because several mid-set songs were spent solving equipment problems [14]
- Cites this show as a reason to consider 1972 the band's peak year [4]
- Prefers the few pre-Europe 1972 shows, especially the Academy ones, and wishes the complete show circulated from audience source [6]
- Second of seven Academy shows; the next night may be the run's best and this one the weakest [14]
- Reviewer hears a decent show that does not reach extraordinary heights [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1972-03-22.132726.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Apogee AD500 -> Dat (48k) [1]. Also: Soundboard of the whole show was circulated by Charlie Miller; Credits Charlie Miller with transferring the soundboard and adding it to the collection; Until recently this show circulated only as a poor audience recording [1][9][11][14]
- **gd72-03-22.aud.partial.19142.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by David Hollister; source: Audience Recording [3]. Also: Partial audience recording via David Hollister; lineage runs from unknown source through cassette, reel, CD, EAC, to SHN [3]
- **gd1972-03-22.136682.sbd.sirmick.flac1648**: taped by Anonomous; transferred by SIRMick; source: Source: sbd > master reel > dat (48k) [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by johnsdeadart.blogspot.com: [John's Custom Grateful Dead Album Cover Art](https://johnsdeadart.blogspot.com/2017/05/blog-post_90.html) [17]
- Fan art by johnsdeadart.blogspot.com: [John's Custom Grateful Dead Album Cover Art](https://johnsdeadart.blogspot.com/2017/05/blog-post_90.html) [18]
